entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-30
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Cycle detection when detecting value converter types over foreign keys throws InvalidOperationException #38301
  • Precompiled ExecuteUpdate reads multi-setter values in reverse order, writing them to the wrong columns #39426
    11.0.0
  • EF Core 10: after `Update` throws an identity conflict, the conflicting instance stays tracked as `Detached` and `SaveChanges` throws "Unexpected entry.EntityState: Detached #39412
  • Windows Defender scans (downloaded) EF Bundle as a Trojan #33294
  • EF Core 10 materializes an owned entity with a null required property for a sibling derived entity #39425
  • Cannot scaffold migration with index on JSON complex property: RelationalJsonIndex literal not supported #39430
  • NativeAOT: precompiled queries over enum or collection parameters throw NativeAotNoCompiledModel #39427
  • Add the *ValuesFactory implementations for complex collections to the compiled model #37750
    12.0-preview1
  • False JSON column collisions for complex properties when a table has an owned JSON entity #39447
    12.0-preview1
  • Invalid JSON column mappings of complex properties do not throw #39446
    12.0-preview1
  • JSON complex property on an optional table-sharing dependent: column is NOT NULL and not cleared on delete #39445
    12.0-preview1
  • NativeAOT compiled model: NullReferenceException tracking an entity with a complex collection #39444
    12.0-preview1
  • Projecting a JSON-mapped complex property with AsNoTrackingWithIdentityResolution throws InvalidCastException #39322
    12.0-preview1
  • IDbCommandInterceptor.CommandFailed does not capture all command exceptions #35229
    12.0-preview1
  • Null compensation is repeated for a nullable subquery used as a value of an inline collection `Contains` #39413
    12.0-preview1

Updated

  • Update docs: The property 'Kind' cannot be added to the type 'BaseEntity' because it is declared on the CLR type 'Child1Entity #36928
    Backlog
  • Add testing for Find/FindAsync with default QueryTrackingBehavior #32762
    Backlog
  • Cosmos: Warn when decimals is mapped without a value converter (imprecise arithmetic) #38137
    Backlog
  • Cosmos: Warn when integers participate in arithmetic (which evaluates them as doubles) #38139
    Backlog
  • Migrator retains every pending migration's target model for the whole Migrate call #39339
    Backlog
  • Checking equality of values with convertible types makes query precompilation fail #38012
    12.0.0
  • Ternary false-expression does not take ternary condition into account, resulting in slow execution on SQL Server #36293
    12.0.0
  • Cosmos multi-vector search #39016
    Backlog
  • Support separate navigation query and update mappings, including read-only navigations #39422
    Backlog
  • Non-auto-loaded properties are not populated on entities even when explicitly selected by FromSql or LINQ projection #39398
    12.0.0
  • Global UseCollation() convention generates uncompilable model snapshot for JSON-mapped ComplexCollection properties #39406
    12.0.0
  • Allow specifying more facets on JSON column #28591
    Backlog
  • Required owned entity on a TPH derived type is materialized for an unrelated row #38659
    Backlog
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #39411
    9.0.x
  • Query precompiler folds conditionals on captured variables using fake defaults and drops a SQL branch #39428
    12.0.0
  • Query precompiler aliases Skip and Take into a single SQL parameter #39429
    12.0.0
  • Migrations: when adding required column with custom converter and unspecified default value to existing table, we don't pass through converter to generate the default "empty" value #33038
    Backlog
  • ToJson complex collection: an explicit DetectChanges() before SaveChanges() silently loses a prepended element and writes the old head twice #39450
    12.0.0
  • SQL Server: a TimeSpan of a day or more in a JSON column is read back wrong, with no error, when a query reads the property #39456
    12.0.0
  • Querying a table-splitting dependent of a derived TPH type returns rows of other types #39458
    Backlog
  • Better translation for COUNT with predicate checking for non-null #26940
    Backlog
  • EnableDetailedErrors: nested JSON complex collection with a nullable value-type property throws NotSupportedException (TryExpression) on save and DetectChanges (regression in 11.0) #39459
    11.0.1
  • JSON complex collection with a property mapped to "key" breaks element ordering: OPENJSON index column resolved to the property #39438
    12.0.0
  • Improved NativeAOT support #34446
    Backlog
  • Improve exceptions for invalid JSON values in JSON column #35863
    Backlog
  • Any method named `Compare` is translated as the natural comparison of its arguments, so a comparer's own ordering is silently ignored (`StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase`, custom `IComparer<T>`) #39402
    12.0.0
  • SaveChangesAsync_accepts_changes_with_ConfigureAwait_true failed #34727
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Preserve implicit conversions in precompiled equality expressions #39482
  • Omit unsupported collations from complex-collection snapshots #39481
  • Preserve captured-dependent branches during query precompilation #39479
    area-harness
  • Preserve independent Skip/Take parameters in precompiled queries #39478
    area-harness
  • [release/11.0] Fix nullable sentinel checks for nested complex collections #39477
  • Fix JSON collection element property named "key" colliding with the array index column #39475
    community-contribution
  • Fix Vally experiment judge timeout forwarding #39474
  • Discover F# explicit fields as backing fields #39473
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0]: Bump System.CommandLine from 2.0.13 to 2.0.14 #39472
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.20.0 to 1.20.1 #39471
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26523.3 to 11.0.0-beta.26529.121 #39470
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.63.2 to 3.63.3 #39469
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 9.0.21 to 9.0.22 #39468
    area-infrastructure
  • Synchronize IncludePaths with ownerEntity on navigation expanding #39466
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39465
  • Remove another race condition in LazyLoader #39464

Merged

  • Fix complex type JSON mapping and compiled model bugs #39448
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Fix nullable sentinel checks for nested complex collections #39467
    community-contribution
  • Visit each IN value once when compensating for nullable values #39414
    community-contribution
  • Translate grouping aggregates as window functions behind an opt-in #39240
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Update Vally packages to 0.20.0 #39461
    area-harness
  • Fix JSON complex property projections with identity resolution #39442
    community-contribution
  • Report command failures while reading results #39405
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Preserve implicit conversions during query precompilation #39313
    area-harness
  • [release/10.0] Fix GetRelationalModel race condition #39423
    Servicing-consider
  • Handle implicit numeric literal conversions in query precompilation #39312
    area-harness
  • [release/10.0] Fix Azure SQL JSON_VALUE RETURNING over nested OPENJSON projections #39299
    Servicing-approved
  • Validate and uniquify complex-property column names #39290
    area-harness
  • Resolve grouping aggregates to the query SQL evaluates them in #39451
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39463
  • Allow changing CLR type without SQL conversion #39397
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39400
  • Compare converted reference-type identifiers by their provider values #39369
    community-contribution
